question_en: Which Ethiopian runner won the 1960 Olympic marathon while running barefoot?
explanation_en: Abebe Bikila won in Rome and became the first Black African Olympic gold medalist.

question_en: How many months are in the Ethiopian calendar?
explanation_en: It has twelve 30-day months plus a short thirteenth month called Pagumen.

question_en: What does the name Addis Ababa mean in Amharic?
explanation_en: Addis Ababa translates literally as New Flower.

question_en: What grain is traditionally used to make injera?
explanation_en: Teff is a tiny cereal grain native to the Horn of Africa and the traditional base for injera.

question_en: The famous churches of Lalibela were carved primarily from what?
explanation_en: The eleven medieval churches were hewn downward from monolithic rock.

question_en: How many hearts does an octopus have?
explanation_en: Two hearts pump blood to the gills and one pumps it around the body.

question_en: Which animal is famous for producing cube-shaped droppings?
explanation_en: Wombat intestines shape the material into cubes before it leaves the body.

question_en: What color is a polar bear's skin beneath its fur?
explanation_en: Polar bears have black skin beneath translucent, light-scattering fur.

question_en: What is a group of flamingos commonly called?
explanation_en: Flamboyance is the best-known collective noun for a group of flamingos.

question_en: Which mammal has fingerprints so similar to humans that they can look alike under a microscope?
explanation_en: Koalas developed distinctive fingerprints independently of primates.

question_en: On which planet is one full rotation longer than one trip around the Sun?
explanation_en: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to rotate but about 225 days to orbit the Sun.

question_en: What was the subject of the world's first webcam?
explanation_en: Cambridge researchers aimed a camera at the Trojan Room coffee pot to see whether it was full.

question_en: What is the name for the boundary around a black hole beyond which nothing can escape?
explanation_en: The event horizon marks the point beyond which even light cannot return.

question_en: Which metal is liquid at ordinary room temperature?
explanation_en: Mercury is the only metallic element that is liquid under standard room conditions.

question_en: What is the largest desert on Earth?
explanation_en: A desert is defined by low precipitation, making Antarctica the world's largest.

question_en: Which sea has no land coastline?
explanation_en: The Sargasso Sea is bounded by ocean currents rather than land.

question_en: What is the capital city of Australia?
explanation_en: Canberra was selected as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

question_en: Which country has three capital cities?
explanation_en: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein divide the executive, legislative and judicial roles.

question_en: The shortest recorded war, fought in 1896, lasted less than an hour between Britain and which sultanate?
explanation_en: The Anglo-Zanzibar War ended in roughly 40 minutes.

question_en: What household object did ancient Romans collect urine to help clean?
explanation_en: Roman fullers used ammonia from urine in laundering fabric.

question_en: Which board game began as 'The Landlord's Game'?
explanation_en: Elizabeth Magie's Landlord's Game was the key predecessor of Monopoly.

question_en: What food container held some of the ashes of the inventor of the Pringles can?
explanation_en: Fred Baur requested that part of his cremated remains be buried in his invention.

question_en: Botanically, what type of plant food is a peanut?
explanation_en: Peanuts grow in pods and belong to the legume family, like beans and peas.

question_en: Vanilla flavoring comes from the fruit of what type of flowering plant?
explanation_en: Vanilla pods are the fruit of climbing orchids in the genus Vanilla.

question_en: Which part of the cashew fruit grows outside the fleshy cashew apple?
explanation_en: The cashew seed sits inside a shell attached beneath the cashew apple.

question_en: Which citrus fruit is used to flavor traditional Earl Grey tea?
explanation_en: Earl Grey is scented with oil from bergamot citrus peel.

question_en: What is the name of the dot over a lowercase i or j?
explanation_en: Tittle is the typographic name for that small distinguishing mark.

question_en: The word 'robot' comes from a Czech word meaning what kind of work?
explanation_en: Robot derives from robota, meaning forced labor or drudgery.

question_en: What is the symbol '&' called?
explanation_en: The ampersand is a logogram representing the word 'and'.

question_en: What do you call a word that reads the same forward and backward?
explanation_en: Examples include level, civic and radar.
